services.value: GCT provides environmental laboratory services including organics analysis (chromatography/GC and GC/MS), metals analysis (ICP, ICP/MS, Cold Vapor), general wet chemical analysis, and microbiological analysis (Enterococci, Total and Fecal Coliform, E. coli). It also offers sampling services such as manhole, tank, drum, soil, and NPDES sampling, plus field pickup, wastewater composite/grab sampling, and on-site measurements like pH and temperature and Total Residual Chlorine.
